text: nice report, so uh what should we do, basically i would not like to think about it as much as i can while still getting some pretty strong capability to make any types of pose or emote whatever you want to call it.
resolution: Direction recommendation (no code): keep rigid part→bone binding as the default (the Lego/MountPoints model already makes it correct for mounted parts), add ONE automatic solver in framework/skeleton/ for merged/organic meshes — voxel-geodesic binding per the req_3487 research (robust to our multi-part non-watertight meshes, seconds to bind, zero cleanup demands) — then bake weight-smoothing + delta mush on top so shoulders/hips look right with no weight-painting UI ever, plus a bind-time pose-sweep validator that flags bad binds loudly. Poses/emotes ride the ruled surfaces: joint-grab workbench (req_0576) + animationDsl action vocabulary (V6); schema joint limits clamp the pose editor for free. Deliberately skipped: joint inference (formation is fixed per req_2809), weight painting, BBW/neural/bone-heat. Build order when green-lit: LBS render path (1-2 sessions) → Zig voxel-geodesic solver + package weights + auto-classification (~2) → mush bake + validator (1-2).
